column1: # Every PR push of September 2026 (one pr.yml run each) with the tier the
# lane analysis assigned it (sel_classify.py) and the tier the selector must
# produce. They differ only where a deviation is documented in `note`:

#                     (source registration / test flags -> no tier of its
#                     own); a file list cannot show that, so the selector
#                     treats every Makefile.cbm change as a build-flag
